ST_STORE.ACCOUNT_NUMBER1.lov: select a.account_number || ' - ' || a.account_name d, a.account_number r from ac_master a where a.account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or a.account_number in (select m2.account_number from ac_master m2, ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0'))) order by a.account_number

ST_STORE.COST_CODE.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || c.cost_desc d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers c where c.cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or c.cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers m2, ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') and m2.cost_status = 1)) order by c.cost_code

ST_ITEM_STORE_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_LABEL.lov: select l.location_label || ' - ' || l.desc_a d, l.location_label r from st_store_locations l where l.store_code = :PAGE_STORE_CODE order by l.location_label

ST_ITEM_STORE_LOCATIONS.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(i.name_a) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_ITEM_STORE_LOCATIONS.GROUP_NAME.sql: (select max(g.name_a) from st_item_group g where g.item_group_code = t.group_code)
